summary.text: Three Gu Immortals who live permanently in Crazed Demon Cave and gave Domination Immortal Chu Du a token Gu worm.

claims.text: Not Immortal is a white-robed rank seven Gu Immortal with a pale face, black beard, long wide sleeves, and eyes that shine like stars. Pang Shan is dozens of meters tall and uses a sixth-layer valley as his chair while half lying down.

Fang Yuan enters Crazed Demon Cave with a Gu worm Not Immortal names as the token the Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics gave to Chu Du. Not Immortal says they have lived there for hundreds of years without bothering with the outside world, will gladly welcome Chu Du joining them, and will not leave the cave. He leads Fang Yuan to the sixth layer and says even they do not dare enter the bottom three layers casually, then brings him to Pang Shan, who has the most interaction with Chu Du and first recommended him. Pang Shan agrees to lend Immortal Gu and killer moves to resolve Chu Du’s alliance agreements.

Chu Du summarizes that Crazed Demon Cave was created by Limitless Demon Venerable in his later years to pursue eternal life, that derivation Gu sits at the deepest layer, and that a huge super Gu formation surrounds it. Not Immortal’s will asks Fang Yuan, after the Hei Fan battle, to go to Crazed Demon Cave and set the Crazed Demon Agreement. Separating Immortal Gu No and Care between the parties is framed as sincerity so neither side alone can break agreements without backlash.

When Fang Yuan’s alliance restrictions are eased enough to speak of the northern icy plain, Not Immortal’s will says their main bodies will not leave Crazed Demon Cave: as long as humanity is not extinct, they will not come out. Fang Yuan reads that the three are bent on researching the cave and that outside commotion cannot lure them out.

On the third last layer, a rock turns into a skinny, short Gu Immortal with a goatee, knee-high to Fang Yuan, and tiny shining eyes. Chu Du names him Secret Schemer, a wisdom path Gu Immortal and one of the Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics. Fang Yuan later notes derivation Gu at the bottom layer under their guard, and that shocking ease of travel in the third last layer would drop their jaws.

Fang Yuan had undergone the Crazed Demon Agreement as Liu Guan Yi and become a member of Crazed Demon Cave like Chu Du. By this return he has already gotten rid of its restrictions, and the Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics have the killer move do not care that can ignore the agreement. They keep Pang Shan away and stay wary of him.
